prompt: A reviewer found these problems in your research questions and plan. Fix each one, keeping every rule for questions and plan: don't give a side equipment or dat

content.text:
Let me fix the three issues:

1. RQ4 & Phase 4: Reframe Q4 to use Rancimat induction period as surrogate endpoint, and start trial fills at end of Phase 2 so Phase 4 has more storage time.

2. Phase 2: Explicitly state university rents oxygen analyser under analytical consumables.

3. RQ2: Reframe as descriptive comparison across batches, or expand to 5-6 batches. I'll reframe as descriptive.

Let me rewrite:

RQ1: Which oxidation pathway — autoxidation, photo-oxidation, trace-metal-catalysed, or enzymatic — produces the fastest rise in peroxide value in pumpkin seed oil across batches, measured against multi-marker panel results at months 2, 5, and 8?
RQ2: Do batches with higher tocopherol content show longer Rancimat induction periods, measured against GC-FID fatty acid profiles and HPLC tocopherol content for the same lots? RQ3 looks at whether reducing headspace residual oxygen below 2% at fill delays peroxide threshold crossing, comparing paired bottles filled under current versus modified flush conditions over 10 months. RQ4 now checks whether the modified bottling procedure yields a longer Rancimat induction period than the current one, using trial bottles filled at the end of Phase 2.

Now I'm sketching the four-phase plan: Phase 1 (months 1-2) establishes a baseline across three batches with GC-FID, HPLC-FLD, and PV; Phase 2 (months 3-5) adds the multi-marker panel and headspace oxygen measurement via a rented university analyser, with trial fills starting at the end; Phase 3 (months 6-8) focuses on pathway identification and process recommendations; Phase 4 (months 9-10) validates using the trial bottles from Phase 2's end, giving roughly five months of storage with Rancimat as a surrogate measure.
